INSERT INTO report_comment ( report_id, report_member_id, comment_id, reason, detail, created_dt ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{reportMemberId}, #{commentId}, #{reason}, #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT rc.report_id, rc.report_member_id, rc.comment_id, rc.reason, rc.detail, rc.status, rc.processed_by_member_id, rc.process_note, TO_CHAR(rc.created_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') created_dt, TO_CHAR(rc.processed_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') processed_dt, rm.nickname reporter_nickname, pm.nickname processor_nickname, uc.comment_detail FROM report_comment rc JOIN member rm ON rm.member_id = rc.report_member_id LEFT JOIN member pm ON pm.member_id = rc.processed_by_member_id JOIN user_comment uc ON uc.comment_id = rc.comment_id WHERE rc.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE report_comment SET status = #{status}, processed_by_member_id = #{processedByMemberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, process_note = #{processNote,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, processed_dt = SYSDATE WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM report_comment
